description: This file defines the class Kint_Parsers_ClassMethods, which extends kintParser and is responsible for parsing and extracting method information from PHP class objects, including reflection, method parameters, doc comments, and inheritance details.

classes.name: Kint_Parsers_ClassMethods
classes.description: A parser class for extracting and formatting class method information from PHP objects using reflection, including method signatures, access modifiers, doc comments, and inheritance details.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Parses a PHP object variable to extract its class methods, including their signatures, access levels, doc comments, and inheritance info, caching results for efficiency.
